source_evidence: You can typically choose among several investment options with an ABLE account, which may include mutual funds and money market funds. You may also be able to allocate funds to FDIC insured savings or checking options.
question: Misconception: If I have an ABLE account, I must put all of its funds into investment funds such as mutual funds.
answer: Not necessarily. ABLE accounts may offer several investment options, and you may also be able to allocate funds to savings or checking options. The choices available can vary.
